what: Threshold guard diverges from pinned Pylint R0801
scenario_or_breakage: The plan requires an exactly min-similarity-lines duplicate to fail, but Pylint 4.0.5 Symilar reports only blocks with effective common lines greater than min_similarity_lines. With min-similarity-lines=8, this would make an 8-line duplicate fail in the new runner while current CI passes it, breaking the stated R0801-equivalence contract.
suggested_fix: Revise the runner and tests to mirror Pylint 4.0.5 threshold semantics, or first prove current Pylint fails exact-threshold blocks and encode that behavior.
